summary:
嬌生最新季度營收與每股盈餘雙雙優於預期，展現穩健的醫療保健業務成長動能。
• 每股盈餘（EPS）達 2.90 美元，優於市場預期的 2.85 美元。
• 季度總營收達 253.1 億美元，較去年同期成長 6.60%。
• 核心醫療保健與製藥業務展現良好的終端需求與營運韌性。
ai_view:
觀點：財報表現穩健且超越市場預期，發出正面營運訊號。對短中期股價具支撐作用，但高達 30.80 的本益比意味著市場已消化部分成長期望。後續應追蹤製藥管線進展及營收持續成長動能。

需留意：整體本益比處於 30.80 的相對高位，估值壓力需持續關注。；總體經濟環境與醫療政策變動可能對未來毛利率造成潛在干擾。

summary_en:
Johnson & Johnson reported better-than-expected quarterly revenue and EPS, demonstrating steady growth momentum in healthcare.
• EPS came in at $2.90, beating the estimated $2.85.
• Total quarterly revenue reached $25.31B, representing a 6.60% increase year-over-year.
• Core healthcare and pharmaceutical businesses demonstrated solid end-market demand and operational resilience.

ai_view_en:
view: Solid earnings beating expectations signal positive operational momentum, supporting near-to-mid-term share prices. However, a trailing P/E of 30.80 suggests growth is largely priced in. Key metrics to track include pharmaceutical pipeline progress and sustained revenue growth.

Watch：Trailing P/E ratio stands at a relatively high 30.80, requiring close monitoring of valuation pressures.; Macroeconomic environment and healthcare policy shifts could pose potential headwinds to future profit margins.
